usage: cox stats [-h]
                 {ingest,roles,tiers,models,causes,efficiency,gates,explain,series,coverage,bounds,spend-mix,chair,examples,system-one,lanes}
                 ...

Load the run corpus into the stats store.

positional arguments:
  {ingest,roles,tiers,models,causes,efficiency,gates,explain,series,coverage,bounds,spend-mix,chair,examples,system-one,lanes}
    ingest              load usage, task, node and launch records into stats.db
    roles               landed rate, attempts-to-land and $/landed per role and model
    tiers               per-role model summaries, a cost-aware pick and the spend it would save
    models              per-role cost, tokens, turns, $/landed and first-try per model id
    causes              quarantined attempts by cause and kind, with sample reasons
    efficiency          cost per turn, cost per landed task, first-try rate, waste share, per day
    gates               what each review, validation and plan gate costs and how often it changes
                        the outcome
    explain             the failure-class breakdown behind one role
    series              per-run summary rows read from the stats store
    coverage            known/total provenance rows for runs, calls and tasks
    bounds              n/p50/p95/max and strict/moderate/liberal candidate ceilings per role and
                        model
    spend-mix           per-model token counts and cost share by class, plus the build-only split
    chair               harness PRs and $, chair $ per PR, hand-finished lands and quarantine $ by
                        cause
    examples            the local system-one backend's training file (JSON lines) from task
                        records
    system-one          shadow-to-on graduation report per role, and a proposal for the maintainer
                        to approve
    lanes               per hour, the average and peak busy lanes and the idle minutes, from the
                        store's run spans

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

examples:
  cox stats ingest
  cox stats ingest runs --db workspace/stats/stats.db
  cox stats roles --json
  cox stats tiers --since 2026-09-01
  cox stats gates --since 2026-09-01
  cox stats explain build --json
  cox stats series --json
  cox stats coverage --json
  cox stats bounds --json
  cox stats spend-mix --json
  cox stats examples --role handoff --out examples.jsonl
  cox stats system-one --role handoff --propose
